metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: gtr
plugins.description: Git worktree management using git-worktree-runner for parallel branch development

plugins.name: telegram-notifier
plugins.description: Telegram notifications for Claude Code sessions - send messages manually or automatically after periods of inactivity

plugins.name: explain-changes
plugins.description: Explains code changes in detail - what was done and why. Uses explanatory style with educational insights.

plugins.name: plan-renamer
plugins.description: Rename plan files from random names to meaningful titles extracted from content

plugins.name: big-picture
plugins.description: When Jev judges the work big, writes a visual HTML summary (show-me style) and keeps it updated while the work goes on; /big-picture opens it in the default browser

plugins.name: claudemd-gen
plugins.description: Interactive CLAUDE.md generator and auditor - encodes best practices for writing effective Claude Code memory files

plugins.name: chat-view
plugins.description: Your prompts as chat bubbles on the right of the terminal, with the send time under each; the time each reply started streaming; start → end times on each turn's duration line

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: A side pane with the session's subagents, background shells and worktrees, with alerts when they finish or fail

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Codex reviews as background jobs with findings to pick and send to Claude, and a CodexReview tool

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: Live context gauge, session length, prompt-cache countdown and hit rate; handover note, compaction and continue past a threshold; resume after a usage limit

plugins.name: memory-watch
plugins.description: A side pane summarizing each auto-memory file the session creates or updates

plugins.name: palette
plugins.description: A side pane listing the session's agents, skills and commands; click one to put it in the prompt box

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: A line above the prompt with unpushed commits and installed mods behind the repo, and /ship to push, refresh the marketplace and update those mods

plugins.name: watchdog
plugins.description: Watches every Bash command, foreground and background: stops one with no output, no CPU and no I/O for 10 minutes (servers and watchers excepted) and tells the model, which decides whether to re-run it

plugins.name: fix-findings
plugins.description: Prove review findings against the code and fix only the valid ones; `converge` repeats failing test, fix and independent review for up to three rounds, and a Stop hook keeps the loop from ending early

plugins.name: effort-pilot
plugins.description: Jev picks the effort level for each prompt and the mod applies it on models where a change keeps the prompt cache; each answer ends with its model and effort, and the last band line shows them

plugins.name: tool-lens
plugins.description: Adds an icon, the duration and an estimated token count under every tool call, and a button that expands the diff of an Edit, Write or file-changing Bash call.
